sources.usage_note: Original paraphrase and citation only; no source article or underlying dataset redistributed. No blanket article reuse license verified.

signals.claim: The report distinguishes collaborative from delegated AI use and identifies access to relevant organizational context as a constraint on sophisticated enterprise deployment.
The January report describes collaborative use as more common than automated use in its November Claude.ai sample. This platform observation does not establish task replacement.

In its November 2025 platform sample, Anthropic reports lower estimated success for tasks requiring more human time. Success is assessed by Claude; this is not an independently verified Data Analyst performance or employment measure.

task_interpretations.interpretation: The complexity-related reliability finding motivates proposing human checks for complex AI-assisted data cleaning. This is a contextual team interpretation; the report does not measure this catalog task or justify a numerical Python or SQL priority change.
The newer collaboration finding adds context for considering iterative report review. Applying it to this task is our interpretation; reporting automation is not measured.

evidence_chains.evidence_locator: Introduction: task success and complexity finding; Chapter 2: definition and validation of task success; Chapter 4: Task Horizons in Real-World Usage, Figure 4.3; Chapter 1 footnote 1: sample dates.
assumptions: An employer permits AI-assisted cleaning of an appropriate non-sensitive dataset.
AI can draft some routine cleaning code; this is a workflow assumption, not a measured finding for this role.
The analyst remains responsible for correctness, and generated transformations can be inspected and tested.
evidence_chains.task_change: If routine cleaning code is drafted by AI, some manual drafting effort may shift toward specifying transformations, checking generated code and validating the cleaned data. The source motivates the reliability concern; it does not establish that this workflow will be adopted.
human_responsibilities: Specify missing-value handling, duplicate rules and valid data ranges using the business context.
Inspect generated Python transformations and SQL joins before applying them.
Check row counts, key uniqueness and unexpected data loss; investigate failed checks.

less_emphasis: Writing repetitive cleaning boilerplate from scratch, if AI drafts it reliably.
more_emphasis: Reading, debugging and testing generated transformations under the assumed review workflow.
skill_implications.rationale: Drafting and validation are different uses of Python. The conditional shift between them does not establish that the broad skill becomes more or less important overall.

less_emphasis: Manually drafting repetitive cleaning queries, if AI drafts them reliably.
more_emphasis: Checking joins, filters, null handling and query results under the assumed review workflow.
skill_implications.rationale: Producing query syntax may require less manual effort while semantic checks remain a human responsibility in this assumed workflow. The report does not measure SQL hiring demand.

limitations: Historical, vendor-specific observations include model-assessed outcomes; success is not an independent correctness audit.
The source does not isolate this catalog's data-cleaning task, Python skill or SQL skill.
Skill directions describe conditional learning emphasis within aspects of each skill, not measured employer demand or job survival.
The mapping is proposed for team review. It does not modify baseline weights, scenarios, personal fit or role rankings.
